name: Moc Chau Culture and Tourism Week
nameVi: Tuần Văn hóa - Du lịch Mộc Châu
summary: VietnamPlus calls 27 Aug–5 Sep 2026 the first holding at provincial scale. The brocade night is 31 Aug at Square 08-5, and the art show with about 10 minutes of fireworks is 1 Sep at the same square. The week closes at Long Sap gate. The next year is check on arrival.
when: 27 Aug–5 Sep 2026. Next year is check on arrival.
